title: Ready for a review
preview: The core mobile flows are ready for your feedback.
body: The core mobile flows are ready for a review. Please take a look at the navigation, onboarding and project screens before we finish the remaining tasks.
The project is in review. You can check its current progress and owner from the project page.

title: Brand guidelines are ready
preview: The visual guidelines are complete; the project has a few tasks left.
body: The visual guidelines are complete and ready for the team to use. The remaining project tasks cover the rollout and final handoff.
Please check the project before the September handoff to see what is still outstanding.

title: Page layouts updated
preview: The main page layouts are complete and the next stage is underway.
body: The main page layouts are complete. We are moving on to the remaining responsive and content work.
The project page has the current task totals and due date if you need to plan the next review.

title: Documentation progress
preview: The first group of shared component notes is complete.
body: The first group of shared component notes is complete. The remaining work covers interaction patterns and the next set of components.
The project stays in progress while those tasks are completed.

title: Onboarding is complete
preview: All 24 tasks are complete and the project is ready for handoff.
body: Customer onboarding is complete. The first-run flow and supporting guidance are ready for handoff.
You can revisit the completed project and its activity whenever you need the context.
